name: Pace E-Commerce Ventures Ltd.
summary: Pace E-Commerce Ventures Ltd. operates as a retailer specializing in a wide variety of branded, customized, and personalized merchandise. Its extensive product catalog features items such as furniture, bedding, baby and children's essentials, toys, home goods, and apparel, alongside an on-demand platform. Shaival Dharmendra Gandhi established the company on August 5, 2015, and its operations are based in Ahmedabad, India.
